frontmatter.title: The Optimal Restriction
frontmatter.statement: When does restricting a gift help, and when does it harm?
frontmatter.progress: Evidence from natural experiments or trials on how restriction affects outcomes, including the conditions under which each kind of funding works better.
frontmatter.bounty: Unfunded. The Question Bounties program will attach prizes once it is funded.

subject.body:
## Why it matters

The case for unrestricted funding is strong but mostly built on surveys of what charities prefer. A science of giving needs outcome evidence, including any cases where restriction does better.

## Where to start

Large shifts toward unrestricted giving, such as funders that relaxed restrictions in 2020, are natural experiments. Comparing grantee outcomes before and after is a feasible first study.
